title: Build (C++20) job fails - sccache cannot start because Azure Blob connection string URI is malformed
signature: sccache server startup failed cache storage failed to read unexpected permanent at read azbloberror code invaliduri message the requested uri does not represent any resource on the server|Configuration

failed_jobs.name: Build (C++20, non-blocking) / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake configure fails: 'Check for working C compiler: /usr/bin/cc - broken' because sccache's wrapped compiler invocation errors out with 'sccache: error: Server startup failed: cache storage failed to read: Unexpected (permanent) at read => AzblobError { code: "InvalidUri" ... }'

failed_jobs.symptom: apt-get install fails after repeated 'Temporary failure resolving' DNS errors for archive.ubuntu.com, azure.archive.ubuntu.com, security.ubuntu.com (separate, already-tracked Network pattern d734e6d0da3ffc69)

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_ubuntu_24

key_errors:
-- Check for working C compiler: /usr/bin/cc - broken
CMake Error at /usr/share/cmake-3.28/Modules/CMakeTestCCompiler.cmake:67 (message):
  The C compiler "/usr/bin/cc" is not able to compile a simple test program.
root_cause: The sccache server fails to start because the Azure Blob Storage connection/container URI it builds contains a double slash ('...windows.net//sccache/...'), which Azure's Blob API rejects with a 400 InvalidUri error. This happens before any PR-specific compilation occurs - it fails during CMake's trivial C-compiler-check test compile, so it is unrelated to the PR's actual source changes (which only touch the CPU/ARM softmax kernel and its tests). This is the same CI infrastructure/config misconfiguration previously recorded 3 times as pattern 08b993dbdc18ccac ('sccache Azure connection string is not trailing-slash-sanitized'), now recurring a 4th time in a different job (Build, Ubuntu 24.04) rather than the GenAI job where it was first seen.
reproduction_steps: N/A - CI-infrastructure configuration issue in the sccache Azure Blob cache backend setup (SCCACHE_AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING / key-prefix construction), not reproducible by rebuilding locally without the same Azure cache configuration.
recommended_actions: Fix the sccache Azure Blob Storage configuration so the computed blob URI never contains a doubled '/' (e.g., sanitize trailing slashes when concatenating the storage account URL with SCCACHE_AZURE_KEY_PREFIX in the CI environment/action that sets these variables).
Add SCCACHE_IGNORE_SERVER_IO_ERROR handling or a pre-flight check that falls back to no-cache compilation when the sccache server fails to start, instead of failing the whole CMake configure step.
Since this is the 4th occurrence of the same signature, escalate to the team owning the sccache/Azure cache CI infrastructure for a permanent fix rather than relying on reruns.
prevention_strategies: Validate the SCCACHE_AZURE_* environment variables (connection string, key prefix) at CI setup time to catch a malformed/double-slash URI before it reaches sccache; add a guard or sanitation step in the reusable CI action that assembles the Azure blob path.
historical_context: This exact signature (sccache Azure InvalidUri on blob URI with a doubled slash) was first recorded 2026-11-06T11:53:20Z and has now been seen 4 times total, previously in the GenAI job (runs 42198977524, 42234699742, 42681233252) and now in the C++20 Build job of this run. The root cause (CI sccache/Azure cache configuration) is identical across jobs even though the job name differs.
